features: ✅20000 mAh high-capacity power bank delivers reliable backup, letting you charge smartphones, earbuds, tablets, and more multiple times, making it ideal for travel, work, and everyday use.
✅Fast charging support with efficient power delivery ensures quick charging for your devices, saving time while keeping your gadgets powered throughout the day without frequent recharging.
✅Triple output ports with USB Type-C and Type-A compatibility allow you to charge up to 3 devices simultaneously, offering convenience and versatility for multiple gadgets at once.
✅Premium Mustang-inspired Nitro Black design with a stylish finish and digital LED display adds a bold look while showing real-time battery percentage for easy monitoring.
✅Built with lithium polymer battery and advanced safety features, it offers protection against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits while remaining lightweight and durable.
description: Power up in style with the GOBOULT Mustang Ampvault V10, a premium collaboration inspired by iconic Mustang design. Featuring a 10000mAh capacity, it delivers up to 2 charges for iPhone 16 and 1.6 charges for Samsung Galaxy S25, ensuring reliable power on the go. Experience versatile charging with 22.5W wired and 15W wireless output, along with MagSafe compatibility for effortless snap-on charging. The strong magnetic hold and built-in kickstand let you use your device comfortably in both portrait and landscape modes. Designed for convenience, it comes with a Type-C input/output port, built-in Type-C cable, and Quick Charge Type-A port for seamless multi-device charging. Its compact, pocket-friendly Nitro Black design with an LED indicator makes it perfect for travel. Built with a Lithium Polymer battery and advanced safety features like overcurrent, overvoltage, overcharge, and overheat protection, the Ampvault V10 ensures safe and efficient performance.
